landing.title: videomk
landing.how_title: From idea to video in three steps
landing.step1_body: One sentence, a few photos or a presentation.
landing.step2_body: Script, voice, pictures, clips and music, in minutes.
landing.step3_body: Edit any scene, then post or save it.
landing.meta_title: videomk: AI explainer videos from a sentence
landing.meta_desc: videomk turns one sentence, your photos or a presentation into a narrated video with pictures, clips and music. English and Spanish, ready in minutes.
hero.title: Describe it. Get the video.
hero.lead: Type or say an idea. videomk writes it, narrates it and adds pictures, clips and music. Ready in minutes.
hero.field: What should the video be about?
hero.fine: Free to start · 5 credits on sign-up · no card
gallery.title: One sentence in. Any style out.
gallery.sub: Real videos made with videomk, in every format. Tap one to watch it with sound.
landing.formats_body: Pick where it will play and videomk sets the format, length and resolution for you.
landing.fmt_4k: Up to 4K for YouTube, 15 seconds to 12 minutes long.
landing.feat_voice_b: English and Spanish narration, one voice or a conversation.
landing.feat_media_b: Up to 100 photos per video, or a PowerPoint or PDF.
landing.feat_clips_b: From licensed sources, with credits added for you.
landing.feat_edit_b: Change words, pictures or timing without starting over.
landing.feat_cap_b: Clear captions that follow the narration.
landing.feat_apps_b: Start on your phone and finish in the browser.
pricing.title: Simple credits
pricing.body: 1 credit makes up to a minute of video. New accounts get 5 credits, plus 1 free every day.
faq.title: Questions
faq.a_own: You do. Images and clips come from licensed sources or ones we create.
faq.a_lang: English and Spanish narration, in the app and on the web.
faq.q_photos: Can I use my own photos?
faq.a_photos: Yes, up to 100 per video, or a PowerPoint or PDF.
faq.q_google: What do you do with my Google or Apple account?
faq.a_google: Sign-in only uses your name and email to create your videomk account. We never read your Google or Apple data for anything else. See the Privacy Policy.
faq.a_cost: Start free with 5 credits and 1 more every day. 1 credit makes up to a minute of video.
